rules.title: Old Homebrew downloads
rules.reason: Homebrew keeps downloaded package archives in this dedicated cache. Only ordinary files unmodified for more than 120 days are offered; installed packages and configuration are outside this rule.
rules.regenerationCost: A later Homebrew fetch downloads the archive again. This needs the original download source to remain available and may require network access; offline installation from this cache will be unavailable until then.

rules.title: Old npm package cache
rules.reason: npm's dedicated content-addressed cache stores integrity-checked package data. Missing cached blobs or indexes are recreated when npm fetches packages. Only files unmodified for more than 30 days are offered; project files, node_modules, credentials and npx installations are outside this rule.
rules.regenerationCost: A later install may download packages again and take longer. Offline installs can fail after cleanup until the packages are fetched again; private or removed packages require their original source and access to remain available.

rules.title: Old Xcode compiler modules
rules.reason: Clang generates precompiled modules from headers in this dedicated module cache. Only files unmodified for more than 30 days are offered. Project DerivedData, package checkouts, archives, simulators and source files are outside this rule.
rules.regenerationCost: The next build recreates missing compiler modules from the original headers and SDK. That build may be slower; the source headers and matching toolchain must still be available.

rules.title: Camera Raw development cache
rules.reason: Camera Raw stores reusable image-processing data here. This shared cache cannot be assigned to individual projects from its filenames.
rules.regenerationCost: Image processing may be slower while cached data is rebuilt from the original images.
